name: ev2-web
description: EV2 web screens. The browser loads plain files; this package only compiles the stylesheet, fonts, icons and the 3D floor-plan bundle that are committed in css/, fonts/ and vendor/.

scripts.build:css: node scripts/build-assets.js && tailwindcss -c tailwind.config.js -i css/src/ev2.css -o css/ev2.css --minify
scripts.check:css: npm run build:css && git diff --exit-code -- css/ev2.css css/src/icons.css fonts/
